Your units and their refit classes. DPS = damage per second before armor. T1/T2 = refit tier.
Enemy units and allied lane creeps. Crystal armor resists energy; shields regenerate after 3 s without damage.
Buildable structures need an engineer; others belong to the map.

Damage is first taken by the energy shield (shield column), then by the hull: the hull multiplier for the armor type is applied and flat armor is subtracted (at least 1 damage, except EMP). Area weapons also hit everything nearby on the same layer (ground or air).
kinetic: machine guns - shreds light vehicles, weak against tanks and buildings
piercing: cannons - the answer to heavy armor
explosive: rockets, mortars, artillery - area damage, best against buildings
energy: Void plasma - strong against shields, weak against crystal armor
emp: almost no hull damage, but strips shields three times faster
Most guns hit only ground targets; aircraft need machine-gun towers, scouts, missiles or flak.
Each vehicle has three module slots. Armor opens at Veteran, system and weapon at Elite. A new module replaces the old one in its slot. Modules are visible on the vehicle.
Refits change a vehicle's class and keep its rank, experience, items and modules. Tier 1 needs Elite, tier 2 needs Hero. You can switch between classes of the same tier or move down the branch.
XP comes from damage dealt and kills nearby. Hero levels go up to %d.

Four long parallel lanes, fortified bases with factories, generators and labs. The main map.
Skirmish for up to 8 players. Islands of a flooded Soviet reservoir in late autumn with the first snow; dams link the home islands, guarded islets and a ruined settlement in the middle.

Skirmish for up to 6 players. Winter: a frozen river splits a dead industrial town; three bridges, the fenced plant on the north bank and a ruined panel district on the south bank hold the richest points.
Huge skirmish map for up to 16 players. Winter: two frozen rivers cross the region and meet in a lake around a ruined island city; villages, depots and bridges between the bases.
A new skirmish map from a random seed: islands, lakes or a river, winter or late autumn, 8 bases, guarded points and a ruined centre. Everyone generates the same map from the seed.
Winter. The panel blocks of Shilovo on the southern edge of Voronezh; the Void portal opened on the ruins of the unfinished nuclear heating plant. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).
A small compact map for quick matches and testing.
A closed arena with four gates. Build walls, towers and factories around the core.
Hold the core through every wave, then destroy the Void portal.
Waves never stop and grow stronger every cycle. Survive as long as you can.
Waves break through four gates. Build walls, turrets, generators and factories that produce units automatically.
Players (and AI) build bases, research and fight each other. The last team standing wins. Leave every player on the same lobby team for free-for-all.

Third winter after the Breach. The southern edge of Voronezh: empty panel blocks, frozen garages and the ruins of the nuclear heating plant where it all began. The colony needs fuel, roads and answers.
Shilovo, the gas station and the garages
Shilovo is ours: the gas station, the garages and the empty blocks. The HQ stands in the yards - this is where the colony starts again.

Shilovo, southern edge of Voronezh. Third winter after the Breach. Our column has come from the north with the last mobile HQ of the colony. The empty panel blocks of Shilovo are the best place for a new base - but a marauder gang holds the gas station and the garage cooperative by the main road and robs every convoy. Set up the base in the blocks, then drive the gang out.
Deploy the KShM as a field HQ in the Shilovo blocks
Clear the marauder outpost at the gas station
Destroy the marauder camp by the garages
Column, this is Command. Drive east into the Shilovo blocks and deploy the KShM there (select it, press Y). That is our new home.
The HQ is up. Now a workshop - the crane trucks can build it. We need trucks and armour.
Smoke over the gas station east of the blocks. Marauders, dug in behind sandbags. Take them out.
Buggies on the main road - they have noticed us.
Outpost is clear and the fuel trucks are ours. Their main camp is in the garages south-east of the road.
Two MT-LBs from the old depot are joining you.
Movement in the garages! Technicals coming from the field.
The camp is burning. Shilovo is ours - dig in, they will come back for it.
The base held. The convoy brought fuel, people and a rumour: the gangs' fuel comes from the rail depot east of the city.

Two days later. The gang that lost the garages ran to its staging camp in the east and called in every crew along the highway. They will hit our base in the Shilovo blocks. A convoy from the city is on its way with fuel and people - hold the base until it arrives. Crane trucks can build towers and walls.
Optional: destroy the marauder staging camp
Command here. Build defences around the HQ - the first raid is a minute out.
Mortar trucks on the main road!
Their whole gang is coming! Drones in the air!
The convoy is a minute away. Hold on!
Their staging camp is gone. The raids will thin out.
The convoy is here. The drivers say the gangs get their fuel from the old rail depot east of the city.
Sortie: the frozen rail yard east of the city
The depot burned, and the signal box gave us the Grad papers. The prisoners all say the same thing: they fled from a violet glow in the south.

The convoy drivers told us where the gangs get their fuel: the old rail depot east of the city. Take a strike group along the frozen tracks - the base stays behind under its towers. Burn the depot, and search the signal box: the depot served the artillery works, and their papers could teach our lab to build rockets. Whoever comes back returns to the base with all their experience.
Recover the documents from the signal box
Strike group is on the tracks. The depot is east, the signal box north of the yard.
Documents recovered: Grad rocket artillery. The lab can build on this.
The depot is burning. Their trucks will run dry by spring. The prisoners keep talking about a violet glow in the south.
Marauder trucks coming down the eastern road!
From the base to the ruins of the Voronezh nuclear heating plant
The rift at the plant is closed, but the crystals are still growing in the ruins. Whatever came through the Breach is not done with us.

Since the rail depot burned, the gangs have gone quiet. The few we caught were not running from us - they fled from the south, from the ruins of the unfinished nuclear heating plant, right where the Breach began. Scouts saw a violet glow over the cooling towers. Take the base's forces south and find out what is there.
Keep radio silence south of the blocks. Something is jamming everything near the plant.
Those are not marauders... The trucks here are overgrown with crystals. Command, are you seeing this?
A rift. It is feeding on the pylons around it. Destroy the pylons first, then the rift itself.
The pylons are down - the rift is unstable. Finish it!
The glow is fading... For now. Command, the war just changed.
